ἀρχαῖοι ἄνδρες ὡς Παύλου αὐτὴν παραδεδώκασι. Τίς δὲ ὁ γράψας τὴν Ἐπιστολὴν, τὸ
μὲν ἀληθὲς Θεὸς οἶδεν. Ἡ δὲ εἰς ἡμᾶς φθάσασα ἱστορία, ὑπό τινων μὲν λεγόντων, ὅτι
pass_a_gloss: ancient men have handed it down as Paul's. But who wrote the letter—as for the truth, God knows. The report that has reached us, according to some who say that
pass_b_english: ancients handed it on as Paul's. Who wrote the letter? God alone knows the truth. The story that has come down to us runs two ways: some say that

choices.choice: handed down as Paul's; tradition language, not forensic proof.
God knows who wrote—Origen's open hedge on the penman.
report that reached us; two named traditions follow.
